result.description: Compact SFX power supply designed for small form factor PCs, delivering 550W continuous output with 80 PLUS Gold efficiency, fully modular cabling, and a quiet 92mm fluid-dynamic bearing fan. Includes protections for over-voltage, under-voltage, over-current, short-circuit, and over-temperature operation. Intended for mini-ITX builds requiring a high-efficiency, low-noise PSU.
result.title: Nimbus Quill SFX-550 modular power supply
